decision_note: Pre-release deterministic catches should not be conflated with escaped defects in Framework health metrics. Evidence is strong inside one project; cross-project confirmation is still pending.
Deterministic acceptance rules can themselves be invalidated by runtime evidence. Product failure and acceptance-model failure need separate semantics before this becomes a Framework candidate.

Static/generic-engine, managed-provider, exact target-runtime and convergence evidence are distinct assurance dimensions. One project provides several independent examples; promotion remains gated by candidate spec/evals and preferably additional project evidence.

The reference-integrity Candidate completed the full feedback-specific prospective loop. After source adoption at 9f677504bafc3a2a8460f81b3b2088341a51a302, genuine downstream App PR #88 ran Task Learning Lifecycle Gate 34118146756 with Candidate provenance and repository-local reference validation both PASS; independent downstream PR #89 repeated the same PASS in run 34118499862. The measured post-adoption outcome is therefore satisfied for this feedback item. Promotion remains Candidate because Framework-wide Stable gates such as exact-target-runtime eval coverage, release enforcement, and final immutable approvals are separate.
